A first mention of the same word is inactive. Ordinary prose with no repeated rare word is inactive; repeated common words (the, of, and), list commas and parallel list items ('Monday ..., Tuesday ..., Wednesday') rarely and only weakly cross the line (about 0.25-0.35 of max).
